name: Embark Behavioral Health
one_liner: Residential, day treatment (PHP), intensive outpatient and virtual IOP programs for preteens, teens and young adults with mental health conditions.
best_for: Teens and young adults who need more support than weekly therapy, such as IOP or day treatment
Families considering residential treatment for a teen
Young people with anxiety, depression or school refusal who need structured, family-involved care
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988, or go to an emergency room
People looking for ordinary weekly therapy or a self-help app
short_description: Youth and young-adult mental health programs at several levels of care: residential centers, PHP, IOP, virtual IOP and outpatient, in multiple states.
long_description: Embark Behavioral Health runs mental health treatment programs for preteens, teens and young adults (ages vary by program, roughly 9 to 35). Levels of care include residential treatment centers and therapeutic boarding programs with 24-hour care (for example in Alexandria, Virginia; San Martin, California; Bend, Oregon; and Benton, Tennessee), partial hospitalization or day treatment, intensive outpatient programs (IOP) of about 9 to 12 hours per week, a virtual IOP (typically 12 weeks) in some states, and outpatient care. The company says it operates more than 30 outpatient centers and inpatient programs across the US. Programs treat anxiety, depression, trauma, school refusal and related problems, with family involvement, and Embark tracks outcomes with standard measures (PHQ-9, GAD-7) in its own annual reports. It accepts many insurance plans and offers free insurance verification; costs depend on program and length of stay.

pricing.starting_price: Insurance accepted (free verification); self-pay rates not published
pricing.notes: Embark says it accepts most major insurance plans and offers free verification; virtual IOP is described as insurance-reimbursable. Cost varies by program and length of stay; self-pay is available at some locations.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says personal information is never sold or rented and is shared only with service providers for listed business purposes, none of them advertising (it uses Google Analytics); deletion right is described only for California residents.

Intensive outpatient programs (in person and virtual)
Family-involved treatment for anxiety and depression

patient_summary: Embark is for a young person who needs more than weekly therapy: you can enroll in an IOP a few afternoons or evenings a week, a full-day program, or a residential stay, depending on what is needed. You start by calling admissions, who assess the right level of care and verify insurance for free. Prices are not published and depend on the program.

availability.note: Programs in selected states only (30+ outpatient centers and inpatient programs); virtual IOP in some states, e.g. DC area and Illinois. Age ranges vary by program.
